items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: In this book we were quoting from before by Horricks, the English book

ctx.x: Yep, my good deed for the day.

You were talking earlier about the pieces you played on clarinet with Basie and there's some more mentioned here in the book. Let me ask you if this is right. In this book we were quoting from before by Horricks, the English book, when he said, "his" meaning yours -- "Gaily
swinging, lucid pure tone clarinet has been liberally utilized in the scores of "Basie Talks" (PIONEER) and "Blues Inside Out," both of which have been recorded by the band for Clef."
